skills_considered.reason: The discovery ledger is owned by other batches; the corrections this reading supports are proposed as commit candidates and in the intake note.
A clinical genotype-phenotype source supplies no therapeutic lever for the reference genotype class; forging hypotheses from it would manufacture a lead.
No compound is tested with a measured outcome beyond clinical anecdote; nothing to send to BLOCK-1 triage.
Scientists do not touch the four current files; every change is proposed as a commit candidate.
The triples are published in the candidates for a blind auditor; the reader cannot audit their own locators.

group_assessment.weighting: A six-centre paediatric-neurology collaboration describing genetically confirmed IESS; WWOX is four table rows with genotype, treatment and outcome. Credible for per-patient genotype and clinical course; no denominator, no electrographic outcome. Not a per-author sweep.

queries.query: WWOX AND (infantile spasms OR epileptic spasms OR West syndrome)

field_density.note: 25 PubMed records tie WWOX to spasms; this is one of the few giving per-patient treatment and outcome.

multihop.note: 36 references enumerated; WWOX is not the subject of any cited reference named in the text; none opened.

entries.proposition: Children were tested from January 2018, not only in the 2021-2022 study window.
Treatment response is clinical cessation of spasms for at least four weeks.
entries.snippet: Response to treatment was defined by a complete clinical cessation of epileptic spasms lasting for at least 4‐week duration during the course of therapy.

entries.proposition: The authors state that response did not include electrographic resolution.
entries.snippet: the treatment response in this study was defined only clinically and it did not include electrographic resolution in the definition

entries.proposition: Row 37 labels a stop codon allele as missense.
entries.snippet: 37 WWOX (ENST00000566780.6) Exons 6 and 9 Chromosome 16 Deletion and missense

entries.proposition: Row 37 alleles: frameshift in exon 6 and nonsense in exon 9.
entries.anchor: Table 1, row 37 (WWOX), Variant amino acid change

entries.proposition: Row 37 failed initial hormonal therapy and responded to vigabatrin.
entries.snippet: 37 WWOX M FUA (2), ES (4) Absent MIC, C HYP FIHT, response with VGB ESC, SF (12)

entries.proposition: Row 39 carries a deletion spanning c.517-c.1056 plus an intron-5 variant three bases before exon 6.
Row 39 outcome is recorded as persistent spasms and seizure-free at once.
entries.snippet: 39 WWOX F GTC (2), ES (3) Absent MIC, C HYP, UTN, SP FIHT, response with ZON PES, SF (6)

entries.proposition: Row 40 (homozygous p.Arg264Ter) is drug-refractory at 30 months after a failed ketogenic diet.
entries.snippet: 40 WWOX F ES (2) Dystonia (8) MIC, C HYP, LSE UTN, SP, HYTR FIHT, poor responder, Failed KD PES, DRE, NAMB (30)

entries.proposition: No denominator of all IESS was collected.
entries.snippet: Hence, the denominator of total number of IESS cases managed at all centers was not particularly looked at.
